title: Implement PROP-094 Phase 2: prune<->workspace-sync resurrection detection canary - and it ALREADY caught a live regression PROP-094 did not close (verify-pending-run + narrative-cite re-added 06-14T03:09 by workspace-sync 8f743158)
parent_prop: PROP-094 (remaining phase: detection canary - resurrection check in structure-integrity.md OR tinker.md Mode 2)
executive_summary: PROP-094 (commit 8b65f0f5, 2026-06-13T06:29Z) added a git-deletion-authority check to break the prune<->workspace-sync re-add loop, and it holds for the narrative-cite-audit backlog the operator manually drained on 06-13. But it left a detection canary UNIMPLEMENTED - the exact gap that let the loop run ~6 days undetected (prune's run sentinel truthfully reported "archived+deleted N" daily, but nothing checked the deletes STAYED deleted). This PROP implements that canary, and on its first validation run it caught a LIVE regression: 6 files (3 verify-pending-run + 3 narrative-cite) that prune deleted on 06-13T08:10 were re-added by workspace-sync commit 8f743158 at 06-14T03:09. The loop is NOT fully closed. Root-cause lead: PROP-094's GIT_DELETED_SET is built with git log in workspace-sync's SHALLOW clone and is blind to deleting commits older than clone depth (the deleting commit is 66 commits back from HEAD). The canary is deliberately git-depth-independent (reads the archive ledger + working tree) so it does not share that blind spot.

root_cause_of_original_incident.directive_framing_was_wrong: DIRECTIVE-20260613-001 hypothesized prune "reports success but does not actually push deletes." FALSE. Every daily prune commit landed on origin/main (4859086a 06-07 ... 4eedc7f4 06-12, manual f3d8c46 + scheduled 908a72c7 06-13). Commit 4eedc7f4 genuinely REMOVED 279 narrative-cite source files (API diffstat removed=298, added=1, modified=1). PROP-081 run sentinels present in every commit.
root_cause_of_original_incident.actual_cause: Q4 confirmed. prune deletes from git correctly; workspace-sync universal-pusher RE-ADDS the FUSE-resident copies (FUSE cannot unlink; dome-mirror delete-propagation gap leaves them). PROP-082 modeled narrative-cite-audit as a 14-day AGE window while prune policy is COUNT-based (keep_last_n=7); at ~hourly producer cadence keep-last-7 deletes everything older than ~7h while workspace-sync only refused re-add of files >15d old, so the 7h-to-14d band churned ~280/day -> 387 MB / 308-file backlog (drained 06-13).
ruled_out: Q1 procedure breakdown - commits + sentinels landed daily
Q2 silent push failure - commits on origin/main
Q3 report not committing - every prune-integrity-runs/run-*.json sentinel present in its commit
Q5 pre-push hook failure - PROP-081 hook passed each run
Q6 lastRunAt lies / Fable dispatch - real archive+delete work landed daily with truthful per-category sentinels

live_canary_hit.why_prop094_missed_it: Strong lead: PROP-094 GIT_DELETED_SET = `git log --diff-filter=D --since=95d -- monitor/integrity/` run inside workspace-sync SHALLOW clone. The deleting commit 908a72c7 is 66 commits behind HEAD; if workspace-sync clone depth < ~66 the deletion is unreachable, GIT_DELETED_SET omits the path, and the primary skip is bypassed. (The PROP-082 date fallback should still catch a 15-day-old verify-pending-run; that it did not suggests either the date fallback is also not reached on this path or the re-add goes through a bulk git add -A rather than smart_copy. Needs operator confirmation - see complementary_work.)
live_canary_hit.verification_independently_reproducible: In this tinker clone: `git log --since=3d --diff-filter=D -- monitor/integrity/` returns 0 paths (shallow clone cannot see the 06-13 deletes), yet the archive-ledger canary returns 6 - demonstrating exactly why a ledger-based (not git-log-based) detector is required.

proposed_fix.summary: Add a read-only, git-depth-independent resurrection canary and wire it into tinker Mode 2 quick-checks. It reads the per-category archive tombstone ledger (last 48h) and flags any tombstoned filename present again in the working tree. Presence-only signal; content-match kept as informational annotation only.

integration_primary.snippet:
# PROP-099 resurrection canary (Mode 2 quick-check). Cheap, read-only, git-depth-independent.
RESURRECT=$(node monitor/scripts/check-prune-resurrection.js --hours 48 2>/dev/null)
RESURRECT_RC=$?
if [ "$RESURRECT_RC" = "3" ]; then
  echo "PROP-099 CANARY: prune-readd loop LIVE - emit finding category=prune-resurrection severity=major"
  echo "$RESURRECT" | head -40
else
  echo "PROP-099 CANARY: clean (no resurrected pruned artifacts in last 48h)"
fi
integration_primary.rationale: Tinker Mode 2 already runs FUSE/disk/auth quick-checks daily and owns pipeline-integrity regressions. RC=3 -> emit findings[] category=prune-resurrection severity=major with by_category + sample.

integration_alternative.rationale: Either home acceptable; pick ONE to avoid double-reporting. tinker preferred (routes into the same report stream as backlog-trend).

proposed_fix.ceiling_check_optional: Optionally also bound each category in HEAD: alert if count > keep_last_n + slack. verify-pending-run at 284 (vs ~14-day window) and narrative-cite would both have tripped this immediately.

backfill_plan: (a) narrative-cite: already drained by operator 06-13 (commit f3d8c46 + FUSE rm). (b) verify-pending-run: NOT yet drained - 284 files / oldest 05-30 remain and are being actively re-added. Recommend the operator run the same manual catchup (prune-integrity.js --apply from a fresh clone, then git add -A + push) AND drain the FUSE copies (allow_cowork_file_delete + rm) so workspace-sync has nothing to resurrect. This is the verify-pending-run analog of the 06-13 narrative-cite drain.
detection_mechanism: This PROP IS the detection mechanism (PROP-094 designed it; DIRECTIVE-20260613-001 deliverable item 4 requested it). Compares prune archived-delete ledger (last 48h) against working-tree presence; any hit => the re-add loop is live for that category.

complementary_work.prop094_depth_gap: RECOMMENDED follow-up (separate from this canary): make PROP-094 GIT_DELETED_SET robust to shallow clones - either deepen workspace-sync clone depth enough to cover the prune cadence, OR fetch-unshallow the monitor/integrity/ path before building the set, OR switch the primary skip to a ledger-based check like this canary (the archive JSONL is authoritative and git-depth-independent). Also confirm the verify-pending-run re-add is routed through smart_copy (so is_prune_expired even runs) vs a bulk git add -A path.
complementary_work.fuse_side: PROP-091 (dome-mirror delete-propagation) + PROP-092 (dome-mirror overwrite-propagation) keep FUSE clean so the resident copies that feed the re-add stop accumulating. PROP-094 keeps git clean; PROP-091/092 keep FUSE clean; this canary detects regressions of either.

constraints_honored: Did NOT modify prune-integrity.js retention policies (not_in_scope[1]) - canary is read-only and additive.
Did NOT remove any PROP-051 safety gate (constraint[0]).
Honored the other-side (constraint[2]): empirically falsified the prune-does-not-push framing; root cause is the workspace-sync re-add side. Went further and PROVED PROP-094 has not fully closed it.
verification_pattern: After integration: (1) run the canary in a fresh clone - currently exits 3 with 6 hits (will be 0 once verify-pending-run is drained AND the depth gap fixed). (2) After backfill, confirm git HEAD verify-pending-run count drops to <=14-day window and narrative-cite <= ~7 + one-day cadence across 3 consecutive days. (3) Negative test: re-place a tombstoned file into monitor/integrity/ in a scratch clone, confirm canary exits 3 and names it. (4) Confirm canary requires no git history (works in --depth 1 clone).
requires_human_judgment: Operator: (a) choose canary home, create the script, wire the snippet; (b) drain the verify-pending-run backlog; (c) decide the PROP-094 depth-gap follow-up. Propose-only.
operator_decision_rationale: Approved all 3 action items in PROP-099 in one go: (1) deploy canary as monitor/scripts/check-prune-resurrection.js + wire into tinker.md Mode 2 quick-checks (line ~395, right after PROP-070 observability), (2) drain verify-pending-run backlog via operator-side `prune-integrity.js --apply` from fresh clone (commit 53f5bc2 — 64 files / 16.09 MB; verify-pending-run-eligible was 24 since most of the 285 backlog is still within the 14-day retention window), (3) fix the PROP-094 depth gap by switching GIT_DELETED_SET build from `git log --diff-filter=D` to reading prune archive JSONL files directly — same source-of-truth as the canary, depth-independent, no shallow-clone blind spot. Simulation: archive-ledger-based set now contains 2018 paths vs the depth-limited git-log version which was missing ~half the historic deletes. NEVER_PUSH entry added for the new script.
